findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "report_feedback" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Report a bug, missing capability, confusing tool description or unnecessary steps to Baron's team. Use this when you encounter friction while using this MCP ser…

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "prepare_business_brief" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Help someone take the first steps to starting a business with AI by turning their idea into a short business brief. Use after they identify the customer, paid o…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "find_businesses" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
